name: Seated leg curl
cue: Pin your thighs and pull your heels under the seat.
research: research.json biomech.leg_curl: seated, trunk 10 deg forward (pelvis tilted, spine neutral), hip 100, thighs horizontal, lap pad on the lower thighs just above the kneecaps, knee 5 -> 100, ankle ~10 deg dorsiflexion, shoulder flexion 45, elbow 25 with the hands on the lap-pad handles. Lever hub on the knee axis beside the front of the seat (far side), ankle pad on the back of the lower leg just above the heel (tools/design/leg_curl.mjs). Seat top 0.30 H (53 cm) so the heels clear the floor at 100 deg. The seat pad is 36 cm wide under the buttocks and 30 cm under the thighs and supports them to 0.07 H (12 cm) behind the knee axis, where the thighs lift off it toward the knee; the knees sit free over its front edge and the calves clear it at 100 deg of knee flexion. The load is a cam on the knee axis outboard of the hub; its cable runs straight down to a guided stack under it that rises 0.05 H per radian of knee flexion (8 cm over the rep). Thighs parallel (hip abduction 0) so both knee axes are coaxial with the lever hub and the single ankle roller stays on both calves.

camera.note: Research view is the lateral profile at knee height (az 95, el 10). Seated, the hamstrings face down onto the seat, so the camera is turned toward them: lowered 22 deg and turned 5 deg toward the rear (az 100, el -12; 22.6 deg in all, inside the 30 deg budget). It sees the posterolateral thigh (biceps femoris) as a band from the buttock crease to the back of the knee, above the seat line, with its tendon turning into the knee pit at the peak, while the knee flexion stays a clean side-on arc (phone stage glow ~2000 CSS px at the stretch, ~1500 at the peak). At el -19 the camera looked up at the underside of the thighs and the glow read as a lens on the seat. The base is a fore-aft rail plus a cross rail and a foot under the lever tower and stack, not a plate, because from below a plate reads as a hull.

skinChecks.note: ankle pad stays on the back of the lower leg
lap pad clamps the lower thighs
feet hang free of the floor at every phase
